notes.title: 🚀 Drone Dash Early Access 0.3.0 Release 🚀
notes.content:
We’re excited to launch Drone Dash 0.3.0 to early access! This build represents a major milestone packed with new features, quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and tons of new content to explore. Here’s a sneak peek at some of what’s new:

🌟 Major Updates:  
  
New Levels Galore: Overhauled the first 6 levels with vibrant color themes and added 13+ new levels to the learn to fly campaign!
Demo Mode: Added demo exports, config tweaks, and support.  
New Tutorials: Tutorials now include instructions on charge pads, fire rainers, and gate mechanics.  
  

🎨 Visual & Audio Enhancements:  
  
Revamped Visual Theme: Overhauled the game’s visual theme to be cleaner and more refined.  
Improved Editor UI: Enhanced positioning, button layouts, and new control_node picker functionality.  
Audio Improvements: Added new music tracks, sound effects, and fixed background music transitions.  
  

🛠️ Quality of Life Improvements:  
  
Preset Manager: New preset editor and manager to customize your experience.  
Editor Enhancements: Editor objects can now be locked, recently used colors persist, and tab order is saved between sessions.  
Fixes Galore: Resolved crashes, path follower bugs, drone effects, and editor glitches for smoother gameplay.  
  

⚡ Gameplay Features:  
  
Interactive Elements: Introduced spikes, shocker, charge-pad single-use support, and landing pad improvements.  
Paint Tool: A new paint system to customize in-game objects.  
Drag-and-Drop Functionality: Easily drag items from the game objects panel to the level tree for quick level editing.  
  

🌐 Cloud Sync & Steam Workshop:  
  
Cloud Sync: Updated paths for cloud sync and improved appdata handling.  
NOTE: This change caused us to reset your savegame data.  
Workshop Integration: Added support for sharing and exploring custom content.  
  

We can’t wait for you to dive in, try the new levels, and share your feedback with us. Thank you for being a part of the journey as we continue to make Drone Dash a fun racing experience for all!

notes.title: v0.2.5 is Live!
notes.content:

Introduced tutorials in the campaign editor.
Save game location updated, your save games may be reset / have to be copied over.
Added tutorials for platform and campaign editors.
Updated logos and branding.
Added bloom to various light emitting objects.
High scores are now paginated and dynamically loaded.
MOTD can be loaded from our central server.

Added new trail effect to drone.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can’t wait to see the levels you create! 🎨🚁

Please join our discord and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 📢 Patch 0.2.0 Now Live! 🎉
notes.content:
🛠️ What's New in v0.2.0?
✨ Major Features

Level Editor: Create, edit, and test your own custom campaigns with our new Campaign Editor.
Deterministic Physics Engine: We’ve swapped the old physics engine with a deterministic one, ensuring consistency across replays and leaderboards.


🎮 Gameplay Updates

 Out of Bounds Penalty: Drones now drain their battery when leaving the map.
 New Obstacle – Spike: Beware of spikes that instantly drain your drone’s power on collision!


🔧 Settings Overhaul

 Graphics Options: Added FPS limit and graphics settings for better performance customization.
 Fullscreen Improvements: Fullscreen modes now honor your saved settings.


📋 UI Improvements

 Goal Times: Displayed above the level preview to set clear targets.
 Consistent Time Formatting: Times are now formatted as h:mm:ss.xxx for clarity.
 Campaign Select Improvements: Level info is hidden until a campaign is selected.
 Replay Enhancements: The "Play Again" button now works seamlessly after watching a replay.


📦 Platform Updates

 SteamOS Builds: We’re thrilled to announce support for SteamOS, now available through Steam!


🏁 Leaderboard Reset

 Due to the physics engine change, all leaderboards have been reset for a fair and fresh start. Let’s see who climbs to the top!


🔨 Miscellaneous

 Recreated all existing levels using the new Campaign Editor.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We can’t wait to see the levels you create! 🎨🚁

Let us know what you think, and as always, happy racing!
